info.title: dotnet-narrativetrace-clarity
info.description: The NarrativeTrace clarity tool (dotnet-narrativetrace-clarity): clarity-scan, clarity-aggregate, clarity-check and glossary. Ships under BSL 1.1 because it bundles the BSL Core, Runtime, Clarity and Glossary assemblies, plus Microsoft's MIT-licensed System.Reflection.MetadataLoadContext (see THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt); the Apache-2.0 dotnet-narrativetrace CLI carries none of them.
